positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Instagram Machine Learning Infrastructure:
As the Feature Selection and Importance expert, goaled on improving model performance, reducing capacity, and automating IGML feature selection work. Explored techniques and created roadmaps for me and two other engineers to obtain insights and improve models through optimization of feature sets, setup, and hyperparameters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Instagram Core Media Infra:
Developed back-end systems aimed to improve the processing of media, focusing on video. Goaled on optimizing storage, latency, and compute needs, and facilitating integrations. Collaborated with external teams on video compression, privacy, and integrity, to ensure compliance and improve performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the Platform team, developed solutions on multiple applications and services as well as internal productivity tools. Focused on highly sensitive areas such as billing, eventing, A/B testing systems and authentication. Worked closely with product, data eng, analytics, finance and devops to design APIs and deploy services that would fit the company’s needs.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Theory and Practice of Creative Documentary
